"""Generate six lengthwise, pressure-varied calligraphy strokes for the frozen 和 scene."""
import json, math
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.interpolate import CubicSpline,PchipInterpolator
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session
OUT=Path('/app/output')
MM_PER_PX=.22185986964255727

def stroke_samples(nodes, ds=.25):
    p=np.array(nodes,float)
    dist=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(p[:,:2],axis=0),axis=1))]
    dist=np.maximum.accumulate(dist+np.arange(len(dist))*1e-5)
    t=np.linspace(0,dist[-1],max(3,int(dist[-1]/ds)+1))
    curve=CubicSpline(dist,p[:,:2],bc_type='natural')
    root=curve(t);direction=curve(t,1)
    direction/=np.maximum(1e-8,np.linalg.norm(direction,axis=1))[:,None]
    width=np.maximum(0,PchipInterpolator(dist,p[:,2])(t))
    press=np.minimum(15,(width*MM_PER_PX+.3)/1.187)
    press[width<.01]=0
    offset=np.maximum(0,11.15-.0967*(press-10.91)**2)/MM_PER_PX
    offset[press<=0]=0
    tip=root+offset[:,None]*direction
    a=np.c_[tip,press]
    # Travel in the stroke's direction before touching down.
    return np.vstack([np.r_[tip[0]-direction[0]*5,-1],a,np.r_[tip[-1],-1]])

def run():
    paths=json.load(open(OUT/'paths.json'))
    s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json');s.reset();p=s.primitives();s.record_start()
    p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.06],speed=.06,settle=3)
    p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.024],speed=.025,settle=8)
    p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.055],speed=.035,settle=3)
    for i,nodes in enumerate(paths):
        a=stroke_samples(nodes)
        x,y=s.geo.px_to_world(a[:,0],a[:,1]);world=np.c_[x,y,.02-a[:,2]/1000]
        start=world[0].copy();start[2]=.04
        p['move_tip'](start,speed=.07,settle=4)
        p['move_tip'](world[0],speed=.01,settle=8)
        # Constant arc speed in 3-D. Feed-forward compensates measured PD lag.
        arc=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(world,axis=0),axis=1))]
        n=max(2,math.ceil(arc[-1]/(.006*.05)))
        tt=np.linspace(0,arc[-1],n+1)
        desired=np.column_stack([np.interp(tt,arc,world[:,j]) for j in range(3)])
        vel=np.gradient(desired,.05,axis=0)
        for k,target in enumerate(desired):
            cmd=target+.08*vel[k]
            q,ok,err=s.ik(cmd)
            if not ok:raise RuntimeError(f'IK {i} {k} {err}')
            s.step(q)
        p['hold'](8)
        end=world[-1].copy();end[2]=.045
        p['move_tip'](end,speed=.02,settle=5)
        print('stroke',i+1,'steps',s.n_steps,'contacts',len(s.strokes()),flush=True)
    p['hold'](15)
    actions=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(actions,OUT/'trajectory.npz')
    Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(OUT/'canvas.png')
    np.save(OUT/'ink.npy',s.ink())
    import pickle
    pickle.dump(s.strokes(),open(OUT/'strokes.pkl','wb'))
    print('state',s.state_sha(),'actions',len(actions),flush=True)
    metrics=s.score();print(json.dumps(metrics,indent=2),flush=True)
    json.dump(metrics,open(OUT/'metrics.json','w'),indent=2)
if __name__=='__main__':run()
PY
